fields.FIR_Description: During the early morning of 2025-12-08, around 04:30, the complainant reported that a grey auto bearing registration number TN-39-YY-1091 was missing from the stand near Mullai Puram Parking Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-08. The complainant, Ganesh Subramani, provided the contact number 9000000240. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Vignesh Subramani, using the number 9000000487. Indhu Rani was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complainant mentioned a vehicle observation and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00282, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Auto reportedly taken from an unattended stand during the night.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, vehicle observation, auto, suspect, parking area, CCTV, witness
